question: How do I turn on two-factor authentication for my account?

gold.contains: look up the Second-factor Auth setting

answer: Once an admin has enabled a 2FA app, open your personal settings, find the Second-factor Auth setting (e.g. TOTP), and scan the QR code or type the secret into your authenticator app, which then shows a code that changes every 30 seconds.

question: My phone with the authenticator app was stolen. How can I still get into my account?
answer: Use one of your one-time backup (recovery) codes, generated under Second-factor Auth in personal settings with 'Generate backup codes'. They act as a backup second factor.

question: After enabling 2FA my desktop sync app can't log in anymore. What should I do?

gold.contains:
device-specific passwords
are the only way to configure clients

answer: Clients without 2FA support can no longer use your login password; create a device-specific (app) password in the security / connected devices section of personal settings and use it in the client.

question: The 2FA code keeps being rejected even though I type it right. Why?
answer: TOTP codes are time-based, so your server's clock and your phone's clock must be almost in sync; a drift of a few seconds is fine.

question: How can I log out a browser session I left open on a library computer?
answer: In personal settings, the list of connected browsers shows recent sessions; use the trash icon next to the browser to disconnect it.

question: Can I see the app password again after I created it?

gold.contains: only have access to the device password when creating it

answer: No. The device password is only shown when you create it; Nextcloud does not store the plain password, so enter it in the client immediately.

question: Can I change my login name?

gold.contains: login name, which is unique and cannot be changed

answer: No. The login name is unique and cannot be changed, but you can set your full (display) name to anything you want in personal settings.

question: How do I stop guests from seeing my profile information?

gold.contains: changing the profile visibility to logged-in users

answer: Set the scopes of your profile fields (Private limits to you and your phone-book contacts) and change the profile visibility to logged-in users in personal settings.

question: I deleted a folder by mistake. How do I get it back?

gold.contains: Find your deleted files by selecting Deleted files

answer: Deleted items go to the trash bin. Open Deleted files in the Files app and restore the folder; it returns to its original location if possible, otherwise to the root of your Files.

question: How long are deleted files kept in the trash before they disappear?
answer: By default at least 30 days; after that they may be permanently deleted when space is needed. The administrator can configure other minimum/maximum retention periods.

question: Does stuff in my trash bin use up my storage quota?

gold.contains: trash bin do not count against your normal storage
do not count against your normal storage quota

answer: No, trash bin items do not count against your normal quota, but the trash bin has its own limit, by default 50% of your remaining quota space.

question: How big can my trash bin get if I have a 10 GB quota?
answer: By default up to 50% of the remaining quota space after active files, not of the total quota; e.g. with 8 GB used of 10 GB, it is computed from the remaining 2 GB.

question: How do I roll back a document to an older version?
answer: Open the file's Details sidebar, go to the Versions tab, and click the circular arrow next to the version you want to restore (click the timestamp to download it).

question: Why wasn't a new version saved when I edited the file twice in a row?

gold.contains: at least two minutes have passed

answer: A new version is only saved if at least two minutes have passed since the last version was created.

question: How do I keep an important file version from being automatically cleaned up?
answer: Give the version a name; named versions are excluded from automatic expiration.

question: Do files other people share with me count toward my quota?
answer: Normally no; shared files count against the original owner's quota. Files others upload into a folder you shared count against your quota.

question: How can I share a file with someone who doesn't have an account?

gold.contains: share files and folders via public links

answer: Create a public link share; a random token link is generated and you can set options such as read only, allow upload/editing, password protection and an expiration date.

question: Can I put a password and an expiry date on a shared link?
answer: Yes. Public link shares offer Password protect and Set expiration date (which disables the share automatically).

question: I want clients to upload files to me without seeing what others uploaded. How?
answer: Set up a file drop: create a folder, enable Share Link, Allow editing and Hide file listing, then send the link. Uploaders cannot see the folder contents.

question: How do I hand over ownership of a project folder to a colleague?

gold.contains: Choose file or folder to transfer

answer: Go to Settings > Sharing, click Choose file or folder to transfer, pick the folder, type the new owner, and click Transfer; the recipient must accept the transfer.

question: How do I share a file with a user on a different Nextcloud server?
answer: Use a federation share: in the share sidebar enter the remote user as username@server-url, click the 'remote' label, and the share is created once the servers connect.

question: Can I turn on end-to-end encryption for a folder from the web browser?

gold.contains: not possible to enable encryption on a folder in the browser

answer: No. Encrypting a folder must be done in a desktop or mobile client, and only empty folders can be encrypted.

question: What happens if I lose my end-to-end encryption mnemonic?
answer: You lose access to your encrypted files; the mnemonic is the only way to access them if you lose your device, so keep it safe.

question: With server-side encryption, are my file names encrypted too?

gold.contains: not the filenames or folder structures

answer: No. Only file contents are encrypted, not filenames or folder structures.

question: If I forget my password, can my encrypted files be recovered?
answer: Only if the admin enabled the recovery key feature and you opted into Password recovery; otherwise there is no way to restore your files if you lose your login password.

question: Why can't I upload files bigger than 2 MB through the website?
answer: Web uploads are limited by PHP/Apache settings, and PHP defaults to 2 MB. Ask your administrator to raise the upload limits.

question: How do I connect my own Dropbox or SFTP storage to my files?

gold.contains: Choose a backend from the Add storage dropdown

answer: If your admin allows user-managed external storage, go to Personal Settings > External Storage, choose a backend in Add storage, fill in the fields and authentication; a green dot confirms the connection.

question: How do I map my Nextcloud as a network drive in Windows Explorer?

gold.contains: To map a drive using Microsoft Windows Explorer

answer: Use the native Windows WebDAV client: in Windows Explorer choose Map network drive and enter your Nextcloud WebDAV address (Basic Authentication over HTTPS is allowed by default on Windows 10).

question: Windows says 'Error 0x800700DF: The file size exceeds the limit' when copying to the WebDAV drive. How do I fix it?
answer: Increase FileSizeLimitInBytes under HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\WebClient\Parameters, e.g. to 4294967295 (4 GB), then reboot or restart the WebClient service.

question: How do I connect to my files from a Mac Finder without installing anything?
answer: In Finder choose Go > Connect to Server and enter your Nextcloud WebDAV URL.

question: What operating systems does the desktop sync client support?
answer: 64-bit Windows 10+, macOS 12.0+, and current LTS Linux distributions (e.g. Ubuntu 24.04, openSUSE 15.5, Alma 8); BSD best effort; Citrix is not supported.

question: On Linux the desktop client keeps asking me to log in. Is something missing?
answer: Linux users need a password manager such as GNOME Keyring or KWallet enabled so the desktop client can log in automatically.

question: How do I change which local folder the desktop client syncs to?

gold.contains: does not provide a way to change the local sync directory

answer: There is no direct setting; remove the existing account connection and add a new one pointing to the desired directory (moving the old data first if you want to keep it).

question: The sync client stopped syncing a deeply nested folder structure. Why?
answer: The client intentionally syncs no deeper than 100 sub-directories to guard against symlink loops; excluded directories appear in the Not synced tab of the Activity pane.

question: I got a 'conflicted copy' file after editing on two laptops. What does that mean?

gold.contains: create a conflict file with the local version

answer: The file changed both locally and on the server between syncs, so the client kept your local version in a conflict file, downloaded the server version, and asks you to resolve it.

question: How do I stop certain files like temp files from being uploaded by the desktop client?
answer: Use the Ignored Files Editor in the General tab of the desktop client to add ignore patterns (wildcards like * are supported).

question: What update channels are there for the desktop app?
answer: Four: Enterprise, Stable, Beta and Daily.

question: How can I change the language of the desktop client's interface?
answer: Edit nextcloud.cfg and add a language line (e.g. language=de) to the [General] section.

question: How do I set an out-of-office reply for my vacation?

gold.contains: Absence section of the Availability settings

answer: Add it in the Absence section of the Availability settings with the absence period, a short and a long message and an optional replacement; your status, calendar and Mail autoresponder use it.

question: How can I add public holidays to my calendar?
answer: Click + New calendar, then + Add holiday calendar, find your country or region and click Subscribe (read-only calendar provided by Thunderbird).

question: I accidentally deleted a calendar event. Can I restore it?
answer: Yes, deleted events, tasks and calendars go to the Calendar trash bin, kept by default for 30 days, and can be restored from the Calendar app.

question: Why can't I edit the birthday calendar directly?

gold.contains: fetch the birthdays from your contacts

answer: It is auto-generated from birthdays in your contacts; edit the contacts' birthday dates instead.

question: Windows 10 Calendar won't sync with my account and I have 2FA on. What should I do?
answer: Create an app password under Settings > Security with 'Create new app password' and use it instead of your Nextcloud password in the Windows Calendar setup.

question: Why does macOS Calendar refuse to sync over my http:// server address?
answer: macOS does not support syncing CalDAV/CardDAV over unencrypted http://; use an https connection.

question: Can people join a Talk call without having an account?

gold.contains: join as a guest without a Nextcloud account

answer: Yes, with a conversation link they can join as a guest in the browser, entering a name before joining.

question: How long after sending can I still edit a Talk message?
answer: Up to 6 hours after sending (Note to self has no limit).

question: Can Talk messages be deleted automatically after a while?
answer: Yes, a moderator can set message expiration in the conversation's Moderation settings: 1 hour, 8 hours, 1 day, 1 week, 4 weeks or never (default).

question: How do I record a Talk call?

gold.contains: Start recording immediately with the call

answer: A moderator can tick 'Start recording immediately with the call' in Media settings before starting, or use Start recording from the top-bar menu during the call.

question: How can I keep external webinar guests waiting until I'm ready to start?
answer: Enable the lobby in Conversation settings under the Webinar section; guests see a waiting screen until a set time or until you dismiss the lobby.

question: Is there a way to send a chat message without notifying everyone at night?
answer: Yes, enable silent mode; other participants won't receive notifications for your messages.

question: How do I get email notifications batched once a day instead of for every event?

gold.contains: Daily sends a single email per day

answer: In Settings > Personal > Notifications, choose the email notification frequency (as soon as possible, hourly, daily or weekly).

question: Is there a dark mode or a dyslexia-friendly font?
answer: Yes, under Settings > Accessibility you can enable the dark theme, high contrast theme, and the OpenDyslexic dyslexia font.
